definitions.assisted_tackle_play_rate: tackled scrimmage plays that carried at least one assist credit, over all tackled scrimmage plays.
definitions.negative_run_loss_distribution: yards lost on runs that lost yardage; key 6+ pools losses of six or more.
definitions.qb1_attempt_share: mean over team-games of the leading passer share of that team pass attempts.
definitions.rank_shares: within one team-game, the position group production ranked by volume: index 0 is the most-used player. These are usage-rank shapes, not depth-chart facts; the runtime maps them onto the coach-supplied depth order.
definitions.rush_share: share of rushing attempts with an identified rusher, by position group; scrambles count as QB rushes; kneels are excluded (separate play type).
definitions.tackle_share: share of tackle credits (solo plus each assist credit) on scrimmage run/pass plays, by defensive group; offensive-player tackles after turnovers (about 2 percent) are excluded from the displayed groups.
definitions.target_share: share of non-sack pass attempts with an identified target, by position group.

drive_model_note: Per-result plays and seconds-per-play are observed pbp means. The runtime scales plays and clock by single factors so the expected team-game totals equal the existing verified baseline (64.2 plays and 10.47 drives per team game). The pbp drive definition counts end-of-half and split possessions that the PFR drive table does not; the scale factors absorb that definitional difference and are recomputed from this file at load time, never hand-set.
information_boundary: 2012 regular-season play-by-play only; no 2013 or later outcome, player line or team result.
purpose: League-wide position-group usage shapes and drive-volume shapes for kernel 2013.4 attribution and the statistical band audit. Shapes distribute already-resolved team production across a club depth chart; they never decide who is on the depth chart, never rate a player and never set a Jacksonville quota.

verification.method: Every share was recomputed from the independently published nflscrapR play-by-play using the same nflverse 2012 roster position map. Values below are the nflverse figures; the verification figures are stored alongside.
verification.position_map_note: Both passes share the nflverse 2012 roster position map, so position labelling is not independently verified. In the rusher/target pass, 2 player IDs in the nflscrapR file had no roster position match; tackle credits without a match are excluded from every group.
single_source_fields: sack_share (nflscrapR 2012 file has no sack credit columns)
drive_model (nflverse fixed-drive fields; totals reconciled against the existing PFR-derived baseline instead)
verification.totals_cross_check: nflverse sacks 1,169 equal the existing NFL.com baseline sacks 1,169; interception credits 468 equal the baseline interceptions 468; pass attempts 17,753 vs baseline 17,788 (spikes and aborted plays classified differently).
